title: Neonatal surgery
objectives: Stabilise CDH, EA/TEF, duodenal atresia and abdominal-wall defects before theatre.
State the double-bubble workup and the operation for each duodenal obstruction cause.
List prognostic markers in antenatally diagnosed surgical conditions (LHR, CVR, AFI).
body_md:
### Why this area matters

This is the highest-yield module in the bank. CDH, oesophageal atresia, NEC, abdominal-wall defects, neonatal obstruction and Hirschsprung variants repeat across sessions with different emphasis — master the stabilisation scripts and half the exam is familiar.

### The stabilisation spine

Every neonatal emergency answers in the same order: warm, position, decompress (orogastric tube), ventilate gently, access and fluids, antibiotics where indicated, then image and decide. CDH: avoid bag-mask hyperinflation, gentle ventilation, pulmonary-hypertension-first thinking, prognostication by lung-to-head ratio and liver position. EA/TEF: suction the blind pouch, nurse head-up, echo for cardiac anomalies and arch sidedness, gap assessment decides primary versus staged repair. Duodenal atresia: double bubble, NG decompression, correct the hypochloraemic alkalosis of associated vomiting, then duodenoduodenostomy — and always consider Down syndrome and cardiac screening.

### Wall defects and obstruction

Gastroschisis (no sac, thickened peel, staged silo versus primary closure) versus omphalocele (sac present, think Beckwith-Wiedemann and cardiac anomalies). Meconium ileus: Gastrografin enema is diagnostic and often therapeutic in simple cases; complicated cases go to theatre. NEC: Bell staging drives medical versus surgical calls; portal venous gas and pneumatosis are the radiology words that matter; free air means operation.

### Hirschsprung and ARM in brief

Delayed passage of meconium, bilious distension, contrast enema transition zone, rectal biopsy as gold standard; pull-through variants and the postoperative obstructed-enters-colitis pathway. ARM workup is invertogram/cross-table lateral plus VACTERL sweep; pouch colon gets its own operative plan; continence is the long game, graded by Kelly-type thinking and bowel management.

### How it is asked

Embryology → prognostication → stabilisation → operation → complications, in that order, nearly every time. Antenatal counselling sub-parts reward the ratios: LHR, CPAM volume ratio, amniotic fluid trends.
